title: STRUCTSENSE: A TASK-AGNOSTIC AGENTIC FRAMEWORK FOR STRUCTURED INFORMATION EXTRACTION WITH HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP EVALUATION AND BENCHMARKING
reasoning: The paper focuses on an agentic framework for extracting structured information from scientific literature, specifically in the neuroscience domain. It evaluates extraction accuracy, costs, and processing speed, but does not include any evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
